overview_description.description:
Wellxa Health is a UAE-based healthcare technology company offering a fully integrated digital and at-home healthcare platform.

The company provides a comprehensive range of services including teleconsultations, laboratory diagnostics with home sample collection, IV therapy, physiotherapy, nursing care, and medication delivery.

Beyond traditional healthcare access, Wellxa’s flagship Health Optimization Program leverages personalized diagnostics, multidisciplinary clinical oversight, and continuous monitoring to deliver data-driven, preventive, and performance-focused care.

Unlike aggregator platforms, Wellxa operates as a licensed healthcare provider, ensuring full clinical accountability and continuity of care across its ecosystem.

Headquartered in Dubai, Wellxa aims to redefine healthcare delivery in the region by combining convenience, personalization, and long-term health optimization.
